## Change

Describe the problem and resulting user behavior.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and results. For UI changes, include desktop/narrow-screen evidence. Record limitations or untested paths.

## Checklist

- [ ] The relevant docs match the code.
- [ ] Changed behavior has an appropriate regression check.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths or unlicensed fixtures are included.
- [ ] Dependency/schema changes include lockfiles, migration and recovery notes where needed.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the terms in CONTRIBUTING.md.
